author: Mark Atwood
text: Handoff context from the vector work (1lgt/gohv, now closed): canonical vectors are test/vectors/relay_signer_chain.json with closed schema relay_signer_chain.schema.json and generator generate_relay_signer_chain.py (python3 test/vectors/generate_relay_signer_chain.py --check verifies committed bytes). 12 vectors: multi-hop A->B->C chain (C pins immediate signer B, payload origin A preserved verbatim from wire_format_v2.json announce corpus), RFC 6554 SRH destination-mutation variant, fail-closed substitution (unknown SIID -> no_candidate_verified; victim-SIID reuse where the attacker key cryptographically VERIFIES as a decoy -> pinned_siid_verification_failed_no_fallback, no fallback), and TOFU cache sequences (pin-on-first-verified-contact, replay rejection, eviction invalidates replay state). Option (b) = no wire change, so no regeneration of existing signed-frame corpora is needed. Python consumer reference implementation: python/tests/link/test_relay_signer_chain_vectors.py (14 tests) against lichen.link.link_layer.LinkLayer _find_sender pinned-first semantics.
